تقتطفي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِفِي (taqtaṭifī) /taq.ta.tˤi.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# تُقْتَطَفِي (tuqtaṭafī) /tuq.ta.tˤa.fiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
